title: Resource Label Group joins default ranks after missing interest payments on leveraged loan
summary: S&P Global Ratings on Nov. 23 downgraded RLG Holdings, the indirect parent of Resource Label Group LLC, to D, from CCC and a negative outlook, after the agency said the company failed to pay interest on its revolver, first-lien term loan and second-lien term loan within the 10-business-day grace periods following their Oct. 30 due dates. title: Moody’s affirms Sanofi’s Aa3 rating, shifts outlook to negative on Insmed deal
